summary: Firebase Remote Config behind IRemoteConfigSource. Game key '.' maps to Firebase '_'.
manualSteps: Firebase is not on a package registry: download com.google.firebase.app-14.1.0.tgz and com.google.firebase.remote-config-14.1.0.tgz from the official Firebase Unity SDK distribution into Packages/ManualSdk/, and add both as file:ManualSdk/<file>.tgz lines to Packages/manifest.json.
Download GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS) / google-services.json (Android) from the Firebase console into Assets/; the bundle id / package must match Player Settings.
Create the installer asset (Assets ▸ Create ▸ PrototypeFramework ▸ Config ▸ Firebase Remote Config Installer) and drop it into RootLifetimeScope ▸ SKU game installers in the Master Scene.
Publish every config key to the Firebase console with '.' written as '_'.
